notes: Official NCAA box score, New Mexico vs Oregon State, 1985-11-30. Player pts computed as 2*fg_made+ft_made (sheet's own TP column was consistent with this for most rows; used the computed value for full confidence). Both teams' FG/FGA/FT/FTA per-player figures reconcile exactly to the sheet's team TOTALS row (NM: 35-43 FG, 11-21 FT; OSU: 24-61 FG, 15-19 FT), and player pts sums reconcile exactly to final scores (81 and 63) and to the periods-by-score line. New Mexico MIN column sums to exactly 200 (5 x 40, no OT), giving high confidence; Oregon State MIN sums to 184 (16 short of 200), so 1-2 individual MIN digits there may be misread but were left as transcribed rather than altered without evidence. Omitted 'reb' for both teams and 'to'/'stl' (OSU) and 'pf'/'ast'/'to'/'blk'/'stl' (New Mexico) because those columns did not reconcile against the sheet's team totals (in one case implying an impossible >5 personal-foul value), indicating likely column-misalignment on this scan; rather than transcribe unreliable digits, those fields were dropped for the affected team/columns. Three Oregon State players (Joe Harge, Ismael Rosario, Mark Kaska) had blank stat lines (did not play) and were omitted.
